name: ParticleExchange onERC721Received forged lien
summary: ParticleExchange trusted caller-supplied ERC721 callback and lien data, letting a malicious collection fabricate NFT ownership and credit an unbacked ETH balance.
notes: The second and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected the vulnerable ParticleExchange implementation.
The exploit changes the attack contract's ParticleExchange accountBalance from zero to exactly 50.126827091960426151 ETH, equal to the exchange's full ETH balance at that block.
